Name: Farm to Table Ready Meals
Author: Speshkitty
Description:
Dynamically generates new cooking recipes that allow you to skip the intermediate cooking stages when making multistage recipes!

This [i]should [/i]support modded recipes, however I haven't done any extensive testing on it.

Downloads.Description: Made it work with Love of Cooking, and rewrote some things - most notable change additional recipes are now prefixed with "Alt"

Manifest.Name: Farm to Table Ready Meals
Manifest.Description: Allows you to cook food, skipping interstitial steps
Manifest.Author: Speshkitty
